correctness.rationale: For piecewise-linear Dirichlet FEM the lumped mass at interior node j is (H_(j-1)+H_j)/2 and stiffness diagonal 1/H_(j-1)+1/H_j, giving ratio H_(j-1)H_j/2. All Euler off-diagonal entries are nonnegative, so the smallest ratio is the pathwise necessary/sufficient positivity step; an explicit independent 3-cell rational mesh yields threshold 1/49. Uniform order-statistic gaps have exponential representation H_i=E_i/S_n. With p(t)=P(E_iE_(i+1)<t)=t log(1/t)+O(t), neighboring rare events meet with probability O(t), distant ones are independent. Blocking at b_n=floor(sqrt(log n)) shows P(n log n Z_n>z)->e^-z, hence 2n^3 log n tau->Exp(1). Dirichlet pair beta integrals give finite inverse moments precisely for q<1; a single gap reciprocal diverges for q>=1. Finite Monte Carlo source diagnostics are not asymptotic proofs.
